digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate; deterministic acceptance-criteria quality lint (P6 family)
propositions: AC checklist items with operational-evidence markers (deploy, prod, live-run, IaC-apply, cloud-state, merge-gate, human-action, drill, store-surgery, recorded-attestation) but lacking [operator-attested] tag are not surfaced until completion-verification time, causing post-claim rework.

A deterministic, advisory (non-blocking) lexicon-based lint extending p6_ac_quality can flag untagged operational-evidence AC items at plan time with high precision (≥70%) and low false-alarm rate (≤5%) to prevent close-gate cycles.
The operator-attested tag matcher must be single-sourced between the plan-time lint and the completion-verifier enrichment path to guarantee agreement on what constitutes a tagged item.
The lint must ship as part of the packaged P6 floor without adding new DET checks, new CANONICAL_DET entries, or criteria_routing.json entries, preserving the existing architecture.
